adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and `Calendar.createEvent` to accept `(event, credentialId)`. `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` and calls `createEvent` once per destination/credential, but most non-Google implementations still select the calendar using only the first destination: e.g. `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` and `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` do `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`. `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` similarly filters calendars based on `mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId`. This means when multiple destination calendars exist (e.g. COLLECTIVE pushes team members’ destination calendars), repeated createEvent calls will target `destinationCalendar[0]`, causing duplicates in the first calendar and none in the others. Only `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` uses the passed `credentialId` to pick the matching destination calendar.
